eligible_history: At least one observed, labelled wage-employed baseline at waves 1–20, irrespective of hash arm
any_panel_history: At least one observed person-file interview at waves 1–20, including non-wage or unlabelled records
resampling: Independent person resampling within each of four assignment-by-history cells; every person retains all test rows; common draws across metrics and raw/Platt outputs
scope: Conditional diagnostic of one fitted object and realised assignment. A finite-sample negative-control difference need not be zero. Pure causal overlap or redevelopment effects are not identified.
